name: Dong Ao Shaonü Meng
source:
The game centers on three girls and women with different fates:

One battles family pressure and bias.

One carries the trauma of injury and lost Olympic chances.

One refuses to let age or society limit her ambition.

Through immersive dialogue, cinematic emotional writing, and a powerful branching choice system, your decisions determine everything.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226590/Olympic_Snow_Girl/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏以三个有着不同命运的女孩和女人为中心：

一个人要与家庭压力和偏见作斗争。

一个人承受着伤病的创伤，并失去了参加奥运会的机会。

一个人拒绝让年龄或社会限制她的野心。

通过身临其境的对话、电影般的情感书写和强大的分支选择系统，你的决定决定一切。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226590/Olympic_Snow_Girl/]Steam[/url]]
